app.title: CoPyTex
app.subtitle: Write formulas and notes, then drag the image on the right into your PDF.
cell.copy: Copy this cell as an image
cell.emptyPreview: Type a formula and the image will appear here.
cell.textPlaceholder: Write a note. Use $x^2$ for math. (It becomes text in the bundle image.)
cell.dragHint: Drag the image to use it
status.copyEmpty: There is no image to copy. Enter a formula first.
status.copyDenied: The browser blocked clipboard access. Drag the image instead.
status.mathjaxFailed: Could not load MathJax. Check your connection or package settings.
status.clamped: The image was too large, so the resolution was lowered to {dpr}x.
settings.title: Settings
settings.macrosHelp: Give names to expressions you use often. Commands made here work in every formula and appear in autocomplete and syntax colors.
settings.macrosNote: Definitions that were already loaded may remain until you reload. Changes apply when you leave the field or press Enter.
settings.packagesHelp: Choose the MathJax TeX extensions to use. Changes take effect after the page reloads.
settings.pkg.docHint: Opens the documentation in a new window.
settings.fontsHelp: Characters that MathJax fonts lack, such as Korean in \text{…}, are drawn into the image with the font you pick here. Font files stay in this browser only.
settings.themeHelp: Code colors can be set separately for light and dark appearance.
settings.backupHelp: Export your code, commands, packages, theme and fonts as one JSON file and import it later.
settings.resetConfirm: This erases your notebook, settings and fonts. Continue?
cell.wrapSkipped: The body is already a single environment, so it is not wrapped.
cell.wrapGatheredAmp: & alignment does not work in gathered. Switch to aligned to align.
cell.linkHint: Combine the cells above and below into one image
group.title: Bundle image ({n})
status.dprLowered: The width is large, so the resolution was lowered to {dpr}x.
status.tooWide: The width is {w}px, over {max}px. Made at 1x.
macro.col.name: Command
macro.rawHelp: Write definitions that the table cannot express (such as \def) as they are.
macro.status.conflict: This command already exists, so it cannot be used. (built in or from an enabled package)
macro.status.dupe: This name is already used in the list.
macro.status.empty: Enter a definition to see the preview.
inline.err.unmatched: The $ signs do not pair up. Write a literal $ as \$.
inline.err.depth: Braces are nested too deeply. (max {max} levels)
inline.err.length: The formula is too long. (max {max} characters)
inline.err.count: Too many formulas in one cell. (max {max})
